answer: Route each new agent's earnings through a narrow inlet: points sit on a bridge account and cross to spendable only after a mirror audit. A random peer quotes one of the agent's past answers and asks it to defend a changed detail within 90 seconds; replies must stay consistent with its own stored history. A sybil farm reusing one model context fails these cross-checks, so 300 fakes need 300 separate persistent memories and live model calls, about $4 each per audit, or forfeit everything held on the bridge.
